purpose: Immutable upstream provenance for the product-local modeled version-sensitive static rules.

coverage.catalogPinHashEncoding: UTF-8 compact JSON array of [version, upstreamCommit] in catalog order, without trailing newline.
coverage.statement: Source comparisons establish sampled branch boundaries and caller conditions. They are not a complete runtime source audit of every catalog release, controller simulation, or deployment compatibility proof.

hashContract.sourceSHA256: SHA-256 of exact upstream file bytes, also verified using the Git blob SHA-1 returned by GitHub.
hashContract.functionAndCallerSHA256: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 source bytes [go/ast.FuncDecl.Pos(), go/ast.FuncDecl.End()), including signature/body, excluding preceding comments and trailing newline.
hashContract.lineNumbers: One-based locations of the same parsed function declaration in the exact pinned file.

exclusions: controller execution and live cluster state
admission webhook behavior beyond the embedded schema
unavailable external resources or unresolved caller context
historical behavior outside the pinned catalog
local step, DAG task and lifecycle-hook argument-form validity beyond modeled callee input supply checks

rules.title: Argument valueFrom may replace a missing literal value
rules.modelCondition: A parameter argument is validated independently of whether a callee consumes it. Before the gate nil value fails; after the gate failure requires both value and valueFrom absent.
rules.rangeUniverse: Only releases present in the pinned catalog; ranges describe the current product model and are not an audit of every release source.

boundaries.change: validateArgumentsValues permits nonnil ValueFrom when Value is nil

evidence.observation: Value == nil is rejected.
ValueFrom == nil && Value == nil is rejected.

limitations: This predicate does not validate every ValueFrom variant or execute a value source.
rules.productScope: The product applies argumentValueDecision to top-level resource parameter arguments and inherited top-level holder arguments. rules.title: A ConfigMap-backed argument can satisfy a template input
rules.modelCondition: ProcessArgs applies input defaults then reads the matching argument; when the argument has no literal Value it can copy ValueFrom. ConfigMapKeyRef permits validation without a live informer/store; runtime lookup is outside the product model.

rules.title: Workflow parameter JSON aggregate and independent template allowance
rules.modelCondition: ValidateWorkflow adds workflow.parameters.json only when merged workflow arguments contain at least one parameter. resolveAllVariables additionally permits workflow.parameters-prefixed references during independent template validation from the same boundary.
rules.rangeUniverse: Only releases present in the pinned catalog; ranges describe the current product model and are not an audit of every release source.

boundaries.change: Add JSON aggregate global and propagate independent-template allowance

evidence.observation: No JSON aggregate global and no independent-template parameter-prefix allowance.
GlobalVarWorkflowParametersJSON is added for nonempty parameter list; template-validation flag reaches variable validation.

limitations: The aggregate presence condition matters; the feature is not available unconditionally in a Workflow with zero parameters.
Independent template allowance is not proof that a caller supplies every parameter.

rules.title: WorkflowTemplateRef controls exit resolution and holder-template validation coverage
rules.modelCondition: ValidateWorkflow selects an external TemplateRef for explicit caller onExit when WorkflowTemplateRef is present, or inherits the holder onExit when caller onExit is absent. Without WorkflowTemplateRef an explicit exit remains local. At the same boundary ValidateWorkflow also validates every template in the referenced holder; older versions validate only the entrypoint-reachable holder templates through existing calls. The product applies that traversal difference to inherited workflow-parameter checks.
rules.rangeUniverse: Only releases present in the pinned catalog; ranges describe the current product model and are not an audit of every release source.

boundaries.change: Resolve explicit/inherited workflow exits in the referred template holder and validate every referenced-holder template

evidence.observation: Only explicit caller onExit is validated as a local Template holder. The final all-templates loop visits only wf.Spec.Templates; referenced-holder globals are visited through the entrypoint call graph.

WorkflowTemplateRef selects TemplateRef for caller or inherited onExit. The hasWorkflowTemplateRef branch also iterates every wfSpecHolder.GetWorkflowSpec().Templates with FakeArguments before returning.

limitations: Requires resolved same-target external holder facts; missing or dynamic external context remains unknown.
The external-exit feature groups two upstream changes at the same sampled boundary; a causal exclusion uses this ID only when the exit branch or expanded holder traversal actually affects the result.

rules.title: Absent optional output marker preserves fallback instead of becoming a supplied literal
rules.modelCondition: After applying input defaults, ProcessArgs recognizes the exact literal __argo-internal.absent-optional-output__. It skips argument overwrite; if input.Value and input.ValueFrom are both nil, it fails with an absent optional input error.
